operations.name: artifact.list
operations.description: List the export artifacts you created that are still retained (any document), newest last, with their metadata and expiry, plus the retention limits. Artifacts of other callers are never listed.

operations.name: artifact.read
operations.description: Read bytes of an export artifact you created (export.artifact) as base64, at most 4.0 MiB per call: pass offset (default 0) and length, and repeat until eof. Returns { artifact_id, format, mime_type, filename, offset, length, byte_length, eof, sha256, data_base64 }; verify sha256 over the assembled bytes before writing a file. Only the creating caller can read it, only while its document is the current target, and (for agent sessions) only with the Read and Export permissions. Errors: artifact_unknown, artifact_expired, artifact_evicted, artifact_released (session stop, permission revoked, document closed or artifact.release), artifact_document_mismatch, invalid_range.

offset.description: First byte to read (whole number, default 0)

length.description: Bytes to read (whole number, default and maximum 4194304)

operations.name: artifact.release
operations.description: Discard one of your export artifacts now to free memory (it is otherwise released on expiry). Returns { released } — false when it was not retained. Later reads report artifact_released.
